limitations: All positions must be relaxed with no fixed atoms. Fixed cell starts from measured rather than PBE-optimized Pd, and the film strain is calculated against experimental CIF metrics, not the paper's theoretical area strain.
Single-sided coating plus three-dimensional PBC can introduce a slab dipole and artificial interslab electrostatics. No cancellation or vacuum convergence is claimed.
Base four-layer Pd is thin; opposite bare surface can affect the selected D. Large changes x image separation, thickness and D dilution together; y separation and oxide thickness are not controlled.
An infinite coherent stoichiometric one-sheet surface oxide is not bulk PdO, a 30 nm foil, an oxide island, a measured experimental interface, or an oxygen adatom phase.
Bulk-cut sheet coordinates omit experimental/DFT rumpling and lateral relaxation. PdO phase retention, D retention, interface adhesion and film reconstruction are open Root acceptance gates.

Alternative symmetric two-sided coating suppresses the coating dipole but costs36host at four metal layers, or31host with only three metal layers and D adjacent to both interfaces. Exact total-Pd matching to ideal clean sqrt5 fcc slabs is impossible without introducing a Pd vacancy, changing metal thickness/lateral strain, or a different loading convention.

matching.comparison_loading: Matched one D per cell and per identical metallic substrate: base D/Pd_metal=1/20, large=1/60. Total D/Pd differs by the explicit deposited oxide Pd: oxygen base1/24, large1/68 versus plain1/20,1/60; this is a coating comparison, not fixed-total-Pd oxygen insertion.

matching.registry_status: One two-O-coordinated sheet Pd is initially above the fourfold hollow of the metal top layer. This is a fully recorded chosen registry, not the optimized Todorova coordinates.
